speech.heard: France generates 67.2% of its electricity from nuclear power. India produces just 2.7%. Slovakia sits close behind, with nuclear reactors delivering 65.6% of its electricity. A tight European pack follows. Bulgaria has 40.9%, Hungary has 40.5%, Finland has 39.7% and Slovenia has 38.8%. The USA generates 17.4% of its electricity from nuclear plants, while China produces 4.4%. Germany produces just 1.4% of its electricity from nuclear power. What is your country land?
